name: Form Effluent Plant
implementation_notes: Effluent Plant Detail grid renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from effluentPlantRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Process Water Detail (screen-075's mobile precedent, screen-072)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23), mirroring FormProcessWaterView.vue's availableTimeSlotOptions() exactly

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom bacaan/status terisi) validated at FE + repo level (effluentPlantRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws EffluentPlantDetailRequiredError) -- UNLIKE Process Water, this station has NO identifying/context columns (no shift/inspector_id equivalent), so all 19 non-time_slot columns (including the 3 enum status columns) participate in the 'filled' check

3 enum status columns (Biogas Flare Status: On/Off/Fault, Dosing Pump 1 Status: Run/Stop, Sludge Dewatering Status: Run/Stop) rendered as native <select> dropdowns with a '-- Pilih --' empty option, styled with a new .native-select CSS class added to this view's scoped styles; local SQLite has no CHECK constraint so no empty-string coercion is required in this repo (unlike the web backend, see screen-115)
UNLIKE Form Threshing/Form Process Water: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no CollapsibleSection, no static-constant data file, per this station's explicit scope

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. anaerobic-pond-1-ph-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide, same defensive pattern as FormProcessWaterView.vue

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): FormEffluentPlantView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('effluent_plant_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/effluent-plant-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Penolakannya (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) semula DIAM; sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan lewat ConfirmDialog — lihat catatan REVISI (2026-10-03) di bawah. Pada sinkron manual screen-006 alasan penolakan tampil per record di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('effluent-plant', mill, date) di EffluentPlantRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Tidak ada test mobile khusus periode untuk layar ini (form tidak punya logika periode untuk diuji). Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), dan mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik). Perilaku write-through (diam saat offline/5xx, rejection saat 4xx) dicakup secara generik oleh mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — syncAfterSave('effluent_plant_record') (mobile/src/services/writeThroughSync.ts) mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; bila server menolak dengan 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) FormEffluentPlantView menampilkan ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label="", mobile/src/components/ConfirmDialog.vue) 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' berisi pesan server, lalu bernavigasi ke monitor-effluent-plant saat ditutup (tombol 'Mengerti' maupun klik overlay); record tetap 'saved' di SQLite dan dapat dikirim ulang lewat sinkron manual screen-006. Offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap diam. Cakupan: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts ('reports the server message when the push is rejected with 422 PERIOD_CLOSED' + kasus diam); tidak ada component test khusus layar ini — test komponen representatif ada di mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts ('shows the server rejection before leaving when write-through saving is refused').
